verification.notes: Body, buttons, ports and MagSafe centre (Apple logo) are Apple's labelled dimensions; a button's pos is its labelled centre minus half its length. The camera plateau spans the full width from the top edge down to 48.9 mm (scaled off the drawing geometry, not a labelled dimension) and stands 2.55 mm proud of the back glass, more than the backplate is thick, so the case uses an open camera cut-out. Corner radius 13.0 mm is a circular fit to Apple's corner profile. Camera Control gets an opening (Apple's keep-out is 25.0 x 8.44 mm; 7.6 mm keeps TPU above the snap groove).
